title: Titan X 50K Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The Titan X 50K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit offers an exceptional balance of simplicity, endurance and flavour. Designed for convenience and long-term value, this smart hybrid system combines a 2ml prefilled pod with six 5ml refill capsules, delivering extended use and consistent taste from start to finish. With up to 50,000 puffs per kit, it’s built to outlast ordinary devices while keeping maintenance to an absolute minimum. Powered by a 1000mAh rechargeable battery and equipped with a 1.2ohm mesh coil, the Titan X 50K ensures clean flavour and satisfying vapour output with every draw. The button-free, inhale-activated design makes operation effortless, while Boost Mode and an LED screen allow for quick adjustments and at-a-glance monitoring. The leak-resistant build and Capsule-Click technology mean every refill is quick, tidy and reliable. The Titan X 50K Prefilled Pod Kit is available in ten flavour editions, each crafted with 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid for rapid satisfaction and smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) performance. How To Set Up Titan X 50K Kit Step 1 Insert the prefilled 2ml pod into the Titan X 50K device until it clicks securely. Step 2 Fit one of the 5ml refill capsules into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale through the mouthpiece to vape – no buttons or settings required. Step 4 When the capsule empties, replace it with a fresh one. Step 5 Recharge the battery via USB-C when the LED indicator signals low power. ✅ You're all set! Titan X 50K Kit Flavours Pure Flavours • Blue Raspberry Sweet and tangy Blue Raspberry with a bright, lasting finish. • Watermelon Ice Fresh, delicately sweet Watermelon lifted by a cool, icy exhale. • Cool Mint Clean, crisp Mint with a brisk cooling sensation. • Cherry Fizz Juicy Cherry with a light, sparkling soda twist. • Lemon Lime Zesty Lemon and sharp Lime for a lively citrus vape. Dual-Flavour Collections • Burst Collection Pink Burst and Rainbow Burst combine confectionery-style sweetness with bright fruit tones. • Drink Collection Cola Freeze and Fruit Punch deliver a chilled cola profile alongside a tropical fruit medley. • Strawberry Collection Strawberry Kiwi Watermelon and Strawberry Raspberry Cherry balance ripe, juicy fruits with tangy berry layers. • Fruit Collection Banana Ice and Sour Apple pair creamy Banana with a tangy, orchard-fresh Apple twist. • Berry Collection Blueberry Sour Razz and Triple Berry mix dark and bright Berry notes for a rich, vibrant vape. With its rechargeable design, high-capacity hybrid system and broad flavour range, the Titan X 50K Prefilled Pod Kit delivers long-lasting enjoyment and easy operation in one compact device.
